notes: Validated against Butler et al. PNAS 2011 (doi:10.1073/pnas.1011699108). 3OWW: Vibrio cholerae tandem glycine riboswitch, aptamer I (chain A, glycine residue 89). COOPERATIVE BINDING: two aptamers act cooperatively through a shared linker helix. Glycine is tiny and non-aromatic, so MacVina calibration does not list baseStacking as an expected term even when local distance checks place glycine near nucleobases; the current baseStacking scorer is reserved for planar aromatic or ring-like ligand systems. Binding is represented here through phosphate/backbone electrostatic contacts. Very weak binder due to small ligand size; not a good VS enrichment target.
